translations.answer: The candidate scheme for Robot-Trains-Robot involves domain randomization in simulation to learn physics latent variables, freezing most of the strategy upon real machine deployment, and optimizing only one latent variable; while the force-sensing teacher arm is responsible for protection, curriculum, perturbation, failure detection, and reset.
translations.applicability: Applicable to real machines with external support/teacher device.
translations.credibility.rationale: Environmental, processing steps, and results have engineering records, but formal cross-validation or independent replication is lacking.
translations.details.attempts.0: Teacher arm follows, gradually reduces, synchronized treadmill, shaping reward, and automatic reset.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Comparing compliant scheduling, fixed-arm baseline, and different assistance/perturbation phases.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: Only optimize one physics latent variable, and the teacher arm schedules and protects.
translations.details.environments.0: Simulation pre-training; force-sensing teacher arm; walking and swing-up.
translations.details.limits.0: This is a paper interpretation; hardware boundaries and statistical results must be verified against the original text.
translations.details.outcomes.0: The post states that compliant scheduling is better than fixed arm; no specific numerical values are given.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: Online adaptation to real machines requires significant human protection, and exploration risks are high.
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Online learning requires independent force/pose limits, failure detection, and physical support.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: Dynamics bias and difficulty jump in real machines cause unstable online exploration.
translations.details.symptoms.0: Learning is weak or risky when the teacher arm is fixed or not scheduled.
translations.media_summaries.0: Screenshot shows text explanation of the teacher arm, force sensing, shaping reward, and automatic reset; no hardware control diagram or safety thresholds are present.
